name: chinese-style-poster-skill
title_zh: 当代中式海报，配方锁在东方审美
tagline_zh: 留白和印色是规矩，不是随便新中式
desc_en: Create refined contemporary Chinese-style / Oriental aesthetic posters and poster-generation prompts from themes, titles, event information, brand copy, products, photos, architecture, intangible cultural heritage, cities, exhibitions, seasonal festivals, tea, incense, craft, museum, commercial brands, fashion, urban culture, editorial campaigns, or experimental cultural subjects. why_zh: 当代东方海报的版式和色，按作者那套走，不跟国潮贴纸混。
limit_zh: 不是喜茶那件，也不是水墨写意。要品牌 VI，另找。
